mapper.select:
/*selectMasterMpIvBuyerNywarhsngListList*/
SELECT /*+ LEADING(C PODT POHD ) */ F_GET_PO_STTS( PODT.BUYER, PODT.PO_NO, PODT.PO_SEQ, 1 ) STTS, PODT.LEGACY_PO_NO, -- I/F발주번호 PODT.LEGACY_PO_SEQ, -- I/F발주항번 PODT.REF_PR_NO AS REF_PR_NO, --관리번호 PODT.PO_NO AS PO_NO, --발주번호 PODT.PO_SEQ AS PO_SEQ, --발주항번 PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, --제품코드 PODT.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION, --품명 DECODE(PODT.SCM_REMARK,NULL,'','SCM') AS SCM_REMARK, -- SCM비고 PODT.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION, --규격 PODT.PO_REMARK AS PO_REMARK, --비고 PODT.UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE, --단위 POHD.PO_CREATE_DATE AS PO_CREATE_DATE, --발주일 PODT.RD_DATE AS RD_DATE, --납기요청일
(SELECT APPROVAL_RD_DATE from KEP_PO_DELY_MNG X WHERE BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = PODT.PO_SEQ AND SEQ = (SELECT MAX(SEQ) FROM KEP_PO_DELY_MNG WHERE BUYER = X.BUYER AND PO_NO = X.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ= X.PO_SEQ)) AS HA_DATE, --합의일
PODT.ITEM_QTY AS PO_QTY, --발주수량 PODT.GR_QTY AS GI_GR_QTY, --기입고수량 PODT.UNIT_PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE, --매출단가 PODT.AGENT_PRICE AS AGENT_PRICE, --매입단가 (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = POHD.AGENT) AS AGENT_NAME, --공급사 PODT.IV_QTY AS INV_QTY, --납품수량
DECODE(PODT.PROCESS_TYPE,'0' ,(SELECT MIN(INVOICE_DATE) FROM ICOMIVDT WHERE BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = PODT.PO_SEQ AND STATUS <>'D') ,(SELECT MIN(INV_DATE) FROM WMSIVDT WHERE BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = PODT.PO_SEQ AND STATUS <> 'D')) AS INVOICE_DATE, --납품예정일
DECODE(PODT.PROCESS_TYPE,'0' ,(SELECT MIN(DELIVERY_QTY) FROM ICOMIVDT WHERE BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = PODT.PO_SEQ AND STATUS <>'D') ,(SELECT MIN(DELIVERY_QTY) FROM WMSIVDT WHERE BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = PODT.PO_SEQ AND STATUS <> 'D')) AS DELIVERY_QTY, --배송확정수량
DECODE(PODT.PROCESS_TYPE,'0' ,(SELECT MIN(DELIVERY_DATE) FROM ICOMIVDT WHERE BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = PODT.PO_SEQ AND STATUS <>'D') ,(SELECT MIN(DELIVERY_DATE) FROM WMSIVDT WHERE BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = PODT.PO_SEQ AND STATUS <> 'D')) AS DELIVERY_DATE, --배송확정일 (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = POHD.BUYER AND TYPE = 'C001' AND CODE = PRDT.ADD_USER_DEPT) AS ADD_USER_DEPT_TEXT,--요청부서 (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = PRDT.ADD_USER_ID) AS ADD_USER_NAME, --요청자 (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = POHD.PURCHASER_ID) AS PO_USER_NAME, --발주자
(SELECT MAX(USER_NAME_LOC) FROM ICOMLUSR X, MIS_BUYER_MNG Y WHERE PODT.BUYER = Y.BUYER AND Y.YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY') AND Y.KEP_USER_ID = X.USER_ID AND Y.STATUS = 'C' AND Y.POSITION_GROUP = 'PA') AS PA_KEP_USER_ID, --KEP담당자
--HIDDEN PRDT.ADD_USER_DEPT AS ADD_USER_DEPT, PRDT.ADD_USER_ID AS ADD_USER_ID, POHD.PURCHASER_ID AS PURCHASER_ID, PODT.BUYER AS BUYER, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = PODT.BUYER) AS BUYER_NAME, POHD.AGENT AS AGENT, PODT.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AS BYIT_COMORG_CODE, PODT.CONTRACT_NO AS CONTRACT_NO, PODT.CONTRACT_SEQ AS CONTRACT_SEQ,
PODT.DS_DELAY_REASON AS DS_DELAY_REASON, (SELECT MAX(PR_USER_NM||'('||PR_USER_TEL_NO||')') FROM POIFLOAD_DOOS WHERE PODT.BUYER = COM_CODE AND PODT.LEGACY_PO_NO = LEGACY_PO_NO AND PODT.LEGACY_PO_SEQ= LEGACY_PO_SEQ) AS PR_USER_INFO
FROM ICOMPOHD POHD, ICOMPODT PODT, ICOMPRDT PRDT , KEP_PM_PA_LIST C , ( SELECT BUYER , PO_NO , PO_SEQ , (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE='M065' AND CODE=S.REASON_CODE) AS REASON_CODE_REMARK , REASON_REMARK FROM KEP_PO_DELY_MNG S
WHERE S.BUYER IN
#{item}
AND S.SEQ=(
SELECT /*+ index_desc(X SYS_C009931 ) */ SEQ FROM KEP_PO_DELY_MNG X WHERE BUYER=S.BUYER AND PO_NO=S.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ=S.PO_SEQ AND ROWNUM = 1 ) )R
WHERE PODT.BUYER IN
#{item}
AND POHD.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND POHD.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND PODT.BUYER = PRDT.BUYER AND PODT.PR_NO = PRDT.PR_NO AND PODT.PR_SEQ = PRDT.PR_SEQ
AND PODT.BUYER =C.BUYER AND PODT.PO_NO =C.KEY1 AND PODT.PO_SEQ =C.KEY2 -- AND PODT.ITEM_GROUP=C.KEY4
AND PODT.BUYER = R.BUYER(+) AND PODT.PO_NO = R.PO_NO(+) AND PODT.PO_SEQ = R.PO_SEQ(+)
AND POHD.STATUS <> 'D' AND PODT.STATUS <> 'D' AND PRDT.STATUS <> 'D' -- AND PODT.ITEM_QTY <> PODT.GR_QTY
AND PODT.RD_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date}
AND C.BUYER IN
#{item}
AND C.GUBUN='GR_NOT'
AND (PODT.PO_NO LIKE #{st_po_no} || '%' OR PODT.LEGACY_PO_NO LIKE #{st_po_no} || '%' )
AND PODT.REF_PR_NO LIKE #{st_ref_no} || '%'
AND POHD.AGENT = #{st_agent_code}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO KEPQTDT ( BUYER, QUOTATION_NO, QUOTATION_SEQ, REVISION, AGENT, AGENT_REVISION, STATUS, BUYER_ITEM_NO, DESCRIPTION, SPECIFICATION, UNIT_MEASURE, MAKER_NAME, ORIGIN_NAME, ATOS_DATE, ATOS_END_DATE, ATOS_END_TIME, ITEM_QTY, IMAGE_KEY, DSS_FLAG, DSS_CHOICE ) ( SELECT #{BUYER}, /* 1 : BUYER */ #{QUOTATION_NO}, /* 2 : QUOTATION_NO */ #{QUOTATION_SEQ}, /* 3 : QUOTATION_SEQ */ #{REVISION}, /* 4 : REVISION */ #{AGENT}, /* 5 : AGENT */ #{AGENT_REVISION}, /* 6 : AGENT_REVISION */ 'C', BUYER_ITEM_NO, DESCRIPTION, SPECIFICATION, UNIT_MEASURE, MAKER_NAME, ORIGIN_CODE, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD')AS ATOS_DATE, #{ATOS_END_DATE}, /* 7 : ATOS_END_DATE */ #{ATOS_END_TIME}, /* 8 : ATOS_END_TIME */ ITEM_QTY, IMAGE_KEY, #{DSS_FLAG}, /* 9 : DSS_FLAG if(chk_str[1].equals("A") || chk_str[1].equals("B") || chk_str[1].equals("C")|| chk_str[1].equals("S")) : Y , 기타 : N */ #{DSS_CHOICE} /* 10 : DSS_CHOICE */ FROM KEPRQDT WHERE BUYER=#{BUYER} /* 11 : BUYER */ AND QUOTATION_NO=#{QUOTATION_NO} /* 12 : QUOTATION_NO */ AND QUOTATION_SEQ=#{QUOTATION_SEQ} /* 13 : QUOTATION_SEQ */ AND REVISION=#{REVISION} /* 14 : REVISION */ AND RECV_FLAG <> 'GD' AND STATUS IN ('C','R') )

UPDATE KEPRQDT SET RECV_FLAG = 'GD' , CANCEL_USER_ID = #{USR_ID} /*CANCEL_USER_ID*/ , CANCEL_DATE = SYSDATE , CANCEL_REMARK = #{CANCEL_REMARK} /*CANCEL_REMARK*/ WHERE BUYER = #{BUYER} /*BUYER*/ AND QUOTATION_NO = #{QUOTATION_NO} /*QUOTATION_NO*/ AND QUOTATION_SEQ = #{QUOTATION_SEQ} /*QUOTATION_SEQ*/ AND REVISION = #{REVISION} /*REVISION*/ AND STATUS IN ('C','R')
